entries.candidate: NEXTDC TK1 Tokyo (28-30 MW planned IT; Minato-ku, immediately adjacent to Tokyo Tower; with CBRE Investment Management)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas, any hold, claim or pending fragment. Status is supported in window: NEXTDC's ASX FY26 results release of 27 August 2026 (asx-20260827-073c04gt4ts40y.pdf, sha256 274d5a5f...) says excavation and retaining works commenced at TK1 Tokyo, and the FY26 results presentation of the same day (asx-20260827-073c08w3kby6d5.pdf, sha256 803bd7e7...) lists 'TK1 excavation and retaining works in progress' and 'TK1 Tokyo: Construction works underway' (practical completion FY30; TK2 Tokyo shown as a future site). The locator is missing: NEXTDC's TK1 page (nextdc-tk1-tokyo.html), its 4 December 2025 groundbreaking release (kyodoprw-202512040376.html) and the 1H26 ASX documents give only 'central Tokyo's Minato ward, immediately adjacent to Tokyo Tower'; Minato City's residents'-voice answers on a data centre next to Tokyo Tower (pages 3826 and 3834, March 2026 opinions) name no lot; a third-party directory address seen only in a search snippet (芝公園4-1-4) could not be captured because www.datacentermap.com answered robots.txt with HTTP 429; MLIT's structural-certification register lists '(仮称)芝公園B敷地計画' by 合同会社芝公園四丁目再開発 (certified 28 October 2025) but nothing ties it to TK1. GSI's address point for 芝公園四丁目1番 (139.744247, 35.659111) is about 120 m from Tokyo Tower but is not an official TK1 locator. Admitting would require an unsourced point.
entries.reopen_condition: An official or operator source fixing TK1's property (lot or residential address, site map, Tokyo sign-notification row, Minato landscape or building record): then admit as civil_works as of 27 August 2026 with the ASX results as status source (or a newer NEXTDC statement).

entries.candidate: (仮称)有明TK2データセンター with (仮称)有明ホテル, 江東区有明二丁目1番65・67・69・75 and 三丁目1番24 (Ariake, Koto, Tokyo)
entries.reason: Tokyo's sign-notification list for April-September 2026 (published 15 October 2026; tokyo-hyoshiki-r8-04-09.csv sha256 fc4b121b..., row 31; same in the PDF) records a notification received 7 September 2026 (sign put up 4 September) for '（仮称）有明TK2データセンター （仮称）有明ホテル' on lots 有明二丁目1番65, 67, 69, 75 and 三丁目1番24, exclusive industrial zone, data centre 59.98 m and 32,972.49 m2, hotel 59.80 m and 19,721.43 m2, planned start 1 March 2027, uses data centre and hotel. That is an in-window government record of an announced project, and nothing in the Atlas, holds or queue mentions Ariake. It is held for the locator: the lots are registry numbers (地番); the 2026 MOJ/AIGID Koto public-coordinate file covers only lots 101-108 and 201-247 in 有明一・二丁目 and none of these; GSI's residential-address points for 有明二丁目1番 and 有明三丁目1番 lie 1.1 km apart and are not lot positions; no map of the site was found. The developer or operator is not named (the 'TK2' name suggests an operator's second Tokyo facility, which is not asserted).
entries.reopen_condition: A site map or lot geometry (Koto ward or Tokyo record, operator release, MOJ registry data, sign photograph published by an authority) placing lots 有明二丁目1-65/67/69/75; admit the data-centre building as announced as of 7 September 2026 (or a newer stage), keeping the hotel out of scope.

entries.reopen_condition: For Sagamihara: an in-window Mitsui Fudosan, Sagamihara City or Kanagawa record naming the site (lot or address) and data-centre use. For Hino: an in-window Mitsui Fudosan or Hino City record (the georeferenced parent-property locator from the 2026-10-17 packet is ready).
